2009

The Recession Tested
Everything

“Everyone took a pay cut so Fusion could survive.”

90% of our clients shut down almost overnight. We diversified into commercial, government, and multi-family — sectors we’d never touched before.

2010

Location

“If you can do what you do out here, the entire project is yours.”

A builder client offered us an entire twenty-year master-planned community — Banning Lewis Ranch. Colorado Springs was born.

2012

Bought Our First Building

We moved into our corporate office on Columbia — where we’re still at today, and invested heavily in developing our leadership.

A Milestone Year

TARGET

$20M IN 2020

We were on plan to hit twenty million in gross sales in 2020.

The biggest milestone in our company’s history — and we were on track, full steam ahead.

MARCH 2020

EVERYTHING CHANGED.

Covid Era

We pivoted instantly — became an essential business, manufacturing safety barriers and health signage across every division to keep our people employed.

Back to the Grind — Continued Growing Strong.

Rebuilt to pre-pandemic momentum through sheer execution — and kept acquiring.

Cracks in Our Foundation.

“If you come to me with a problem, you’d better come to me with a solution.”

I believe this can be a problem. Here’s what I think the solution should be.

My Belief.

“Our leadership and experience can strengthen our foundation for future growth — but without action, we risk losing the culture we’ve built over the past 20 years.”

Closing

Twenty years ago, this company started in an empty warehouse with twelve people and one decision — to do things right.

Every crisis, every acquisition, every year of growth since then came down to protecting that decision.

I’m asking this room to help me protect it for the next twenty.

Thank You.
